summary: Claude Opus 5.5 builds a procedural, code-only 3D supercar configurator featuring dynamic paint changes, custom wheels, animated scissor doors, detailed V12 engine view, night mode, and a drive-off animation.

post.originalText:
Claude Opus 5.5 vs Claude Sonnet 5.5: “build a 3D supercar configurator.”

Paint, wheels, scissor doors, V12 engine, night mode and the drive-off. All code, no assets.

Opus 5.5 (High): 1h 48m, ~$32.69
Sonnet 5.5 (High): 2h 33m, ~$45.11

Which one would you buy? https://t.co/gUzCHnOAwk
